title: xDrip+Bubble
symptom: After the developer of the bubble updated the firmware of my device to 2.0 xDrip stopped receiving glucose data. The program from the developer of the bubble (diabox) receives data from the bubble device as expected.
fix: Use the latest xdrip nightly. Issue is solved there.
evidence_quote: Please use the latest xdrip nightly. Issue is solved there.
